mentions.name: Cardputer thermostat control app
mentions.description: An app written for the M5Stack Cardputer that controls the author's thermostat remotely, built with a deliberately overengineered amount of concurrency using FreeRTOS.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been writing an app for Cardputer to control my thermostat remotely, and I've had a lot of fun grossly overengineering the needless amount of concurrency I have added through FreeRTOS.
